name: Dirty Flamenco, live
description: Here's Dirty Flamenco playing live at a private event, with flamenco guitar, bass and percussion. They're one of the few flamenco groups in Colorado.
more: Flamenco is a lot of fun to watch, so Dirty Flamenco is a great act for a cultural event or a reception. They play real flamenco forms and rumba, both the traditional way and with a soulful twist, and they headlined Dazzle as a four-piece in 2024.
